AcademicCredential.name: AcademicCredential
AcademicCredential.description: A credential which can be earned by learners.

IssuerId.description: The Account of the issuer institution associated with the Academic Credential.

Name.description: The name of the Academic Credential.

Type.description: Specifies the type of Academic Credential.

AwardingBodyIdentifier.description: The ID of the awarding body for the academic credential.

FieldOfStudy.description: The field of study that's associated with the academic credential.

FieldOfStudyPercentage.description: The percentage of the overall academic credential that's related to the field of study.

IttSpecialization.description: Identifies the Initial Teacher Training specialization that's associated with the academic credential.

QualificationCategory.description: Specifies the type and level of the qualification that's associated with the academic credential.

AcademicCredential.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.
